description: This file contains functions for upgrading Netgear Orbi devices, specifically handling flashing new kernel and root filesystem images, preparing the device, and performing necessary steps for firmware upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_netgear_orbi_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that verifies prerequisites, determines partition locations, and triggers flashing and reboot.

methods.name: netgear_orbi_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the actual flashing of kernel and root filesystem, handling loopback device setup, extracting files from tar archive, and filesystem preparation.
